A1.justification: Both complete PDFs describe the same DGPO study. Text, equations, figures, tables and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching v3 Appendix E to relocated material in v4.

before.justification: v3 reports original QA benchmark results, capability evaluations, component ablations and training curves in Section 5 and Appendices D–E.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments and additionally reports SFT→PPO benchmark results and teacher-inference training-time overhead.

M1.justification: DGPO retains KD initialization on correct teacher outputs, PPO optimization and selective teacher KL penalties for incorrect answers. Equations 1–4 and token masking are unchanged; the added action-sequencing explanation does not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both train on NQ and HotpotQA and evaluate NQ, TriviaQA, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue and Bamboogle. The end-to-end and capability-isolation test scenarios remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 2 adds SFT→PPO for Qwen2.5 3B→0.5B. The existing PPO, GKD, SeqKD, KD, DistiLLM and TAID comparators remain, as do the comparison sets in the appendix.

E3.justification: The added SFT→PPO experiment evaluates PPO after a standard supervised warm start, introducing an initialization control. Existing splits, metrics, retrieval settings and Appendix B training parameters are unchanged.

E4.justification: The SFT→PPO comparison adds a focused check of whether ordinary supervised initialization followed by RL accounts for DGPO's benefit. v4 also assesses teacher-training overhead. Existing component ablations and training-stability analyses are retained; moving Appendix E into the main text adds no new stability evidence.

E5.justification: Appendix B.3 states in both versions that each model was trained once. Neither version reports additional seeds, repeated runs, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: v4 adds seven SFT→PPO benchmark scores, averaging 0.289 EM in Table 2, and reports 9.5% training-time overhead from teacher inference in Limitations. Existing numerical results, including DGPO's 0.329 average and Appendix D results, remain unchanged. The relocated training curves preserve their data.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–6 are retained without substantive changes. Renaming ARC to ARCap and expanding the action-format explanation introduce no new theory, assumptions or proofs.

C1.justification: Both versions claim that DGPO stabilizes compact-model agentic RAG, improves over RL/distillation baselines and sometimes surpasses the teacher, alongside capability-level evaluation. v4's introduction emphasizes cross-family results already reported in v3 without changing the contribution's scope.

C2.justification: Section 5.2 newly interprets the limited SFT→PPO gain through compact-model capacity constraints and contrasts hard-target supervision with KD's soft distributions. Limitations adds an explicit judgment that the 9.5% teacher overhead is modest relative to stability and performance benefits.

D1.justification: v4 newly supplies project, code and model access links on its first page and quantifies training-time overhead for a 3B inference-only teacher with a 0.5B student. Existing prompts, hardware and hyperparameters are retained. The linked resources were not accessed.

R1.justification: The cited research and substantive positioning remain unchanged. DeepSeek-R1 changes from the DeepSeek-AI preprint citation to the Guo et al. Nature publication of the same work; other related-work edits primarily clarify wording.

P1.justification: ARC becomes ARCap throughout. Appendix E's discussions move into Sections 3.3 and 5.7, with a corresponding Q4 added. Local explanations, affiliations, acknowledgements and limitations are edited, while most prose and the overall section structure remain intact.

P2.justification: v4 broadly redesigns tables with colored rankings, model labels and boxed teacher-surpassing scores. Table 6 gains component columns, and Tables 7–8 are compacted or restructured. Stability plots move into the main text, Figure 6 is resized, and Figure 3 adds a marker redisplaying DGPO's existing result.

improvement.justification: The added SFT→PPO control strengthens comparison with ordinary supervised warm-started RL: Table 2 reports 0.289 versus DGPO's unchanged 0.329. Cost disclosure, resource links and integration of existing stability evidence improve transparency and accessibility. These are limited gains; the central results and single-run evaluation design remain unchanged.
